events.description: 57. Minute Entry for proceedings held before Judge Maria Antongiorgi-Jordan: Preliminary Injunction Hearing held on 9/27/2024. Present were attorneys Fermin Luis Arraiza-Navas and Guillermo J. Ramos-Luina on behalf of the plaintiffs, and attorneys Veronica Ferraluoli-Hornedo, Idza Diaz-Rivera, Marcia I. Perez-Llavona, Juan M. Frontera-Suau, Jose J. Lamas-Rivera, Juan Carlos Ramirez-Ortiz and Gerardo De Jesus Annoni on behalf of the defendants. The plaintiffs made initial statements regarding this case and the remedies they were seeking. They also announced that they planned to present the testimony of expert witness, Hector Acevedo. The defense opposed, given that they had not been notified of this testimony beforehand. The Court made a ruling from the bench to exclude the expert witness testimony. The defense questioned the jurisdiction of the court. They also informed the Court that they opposed the consolidation of the preliminary injunction with a trial on the merits, and they also moved to strike the amended complaint filed by the defense hours before the hearing. After having heard the parties, the Court ordered a brief recess until 1:30PM. After reconvening in the afternoon, the sworn testimonies of both the Secretary of the CEE, Rolando Cuevas Colon, and plaintiff Victor Altieri Garcia were heard. Direct, cross exam, and redirect made. No other witnesses were presented by plaintiffs. No witnesses were presented by defendants. Rule 50 motion heard on the issues of jurisdiction and failure to state a claim. The Court granted the motion only as to the issue of failure to state a claim as to co-plaintiffs Espritu, Vazquez and Torres. The plaintiff's requested that the Court allow them to do an offer of proof as to what the expert witness would have testified had he been permitted to do so. The Court granted the plaintiff's request and a proffer was heard. The Court held the jurisdictional matter in abeyance and informed the defendant's that they shall have until the end of today to file their motion to dismiss the amended complaint. (Court Reporter Joe Reynosa.)(Hearing held in Courtroom 2.) (aa) (Entered: 10/03/2024)
